rounds.text: The most compelling evidence of underlying operational improvement is the remarkable turnaround in profitability, evidenced by the operating margin expanding by 12 percentage points from -13% three years earlier to -2% in the trailing twelve months [E29]. This trajectory demonstrates management's ability to drive structural cost efficiencies and scale the business toward sustainable profitability. Furthermore, the company's return on assets sits at a competitive 1.38% relative to the sector benchmark of 2.25% [E8], showing that asset productivity is not drastically disconnected from industry norms despite the historical margin pressures. Market participants are also validating this positive momentum, as evidenced by the stock trading firmly in the upper tier of its annual range at 85% of the way up its 52-week low-high span [E5]. Conceded: the valuation multiples, including a price-to-book ratio of 28.73x against a sector benchmark of 1.23x [E7], a trailing price-to-earnings ratio of 1691 [E1], and a discounted cash flow valuation pointing to an intrinsic value of Rs 1 per share [E42], clearly highlight significant near-term valuation headwinds.
